title: The API: queue, watch, fetch
hook: Everything the page does, a script can do: POST a prompt, read events from a websocket, fetch the files.

verified.claim: Validation runs inside POST /prompt, and a bad graph gets a 400 with error and node_errors.
A client prompt_id must be a canonical lowercase UUID.
Event order for first, cached, failing and interrupted jobs, captured from the real executor on a CPU with a recording fake server.
prompt_worker sends executing with a null node after every job.
A prompt with one bad output of two passes validation and lists the bad one in node_errors.
GET /history/{id} returns an empty dict for a job that has no entry.
Routes also exist with /api in front.
The graph a_save_preview validated and ran on a CPU.

unchecked: The lab is a stub, and its timing says nothing about a real server. We did not post to a live server for this lesson. The executor run used a stand-in for the server, so the HTTP layer and the socket sends were read, not run.
